manual_reference.quote: COCO annotations can omit objects or contain ambiguous counts. Inspect labels independently of model predictions; keep evaluation images out of training and replay.
manual_reference.interpretation: Requires label inspection independent of predictions; does not explicitly require the student personally to review all 88 pairs.

timing: Supplementary inspection after training; predictions and correctness were not used to choose label judgments. Original pretraining assistant notes are preserved separately.
policy: Original examples, targets, primary scores, and previous notes remain unchanged. Uncertainty flags are limitations, not definitive label errors, relabels, or exclusions. Contact-sheet inspection cannot establish exhaustive object counts.
